title: Sell Mineral Rights in Greensburg, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Greensburg, PA
metaDescription: Own mineral rights in or near Greensburg, the Westmoreland County seat? We buy Marcellus royalty and legacy gas interests. Straight talk, no pressure to sign anything.
heroLead: Every Westmoreland County mineral deed eventually runs through the Greensburg courthouse, which makes the county seat the natural starting point for sorting out what a family actually owns.
intro: Greensburg is the Westmoreland County seat, sitting along the old Lincoln Highway, and its Recorder of Deeds office holds the title history for everything from downtown parcels to the farmland spread across the county's outlying townships. If you own mineral rights anywhere in Westmoreland County, odds are the paper trail eventually leads back to that building.

We buy mineral and royalty interests from owners with land in and around Greensburg, whether the tract in question sits inside the borough or out in one of the surrounding townships where most of the county's actual gas activity happens.

sections.heading: Greensburg as the county's title hub
paragraphs: Because Greensburg houses the recorder's office, we frequently start any Westmoreland County review there, pulling the recorded chain of title on a tract before we ever talk numbers. Owners who already have copies of their deeds, leases, or probate records save real time in this step.

Development activity itself is concentrated more in the surrounding townships than in the borough proper, so a Greensburg mailing address doesn't necessarily tell us much about whether your specific tract is producing.

sections.heading: Mixed mineral history across the county
paragraphs: Westmoreland County has old coal severances, legacy shallow gas wells, and modern Marcellus leases layered across different parts of the county, sometimes on the same family's land. Sorting out which era's paperwork actually governs your current interest is part of what we do before making an offer.

sections.heading: What we need from you to move forward
paragraphs: Any lease, division order, or royalty statement you have speeds up the review, but we can also work from just a parcel description and pull records ourselves if that's all you've got.

faqs.question: Do you buy mineral rights inside Greensburg borough itself, or just the surrounding townships?
faqs.answer: Both. We review interests anywhere in Westmoreland County, though most of the county's actual drilling activity sits in the outlying townships rather than the borough.

faqs.question: I don't have my deed, only a parcel number. Can you still look into it?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can pull recorded documents ourselves through the Greensburg Recorder of Deeds using a parcel description or prior owner's name.

faqs.question: Is Westmoreland County part of the core Marcellus wet-gas area?
faqs.answer: It's within reach of the wet-gas fairway that runs through southwestern Pennsylvania, though development is more scattered here than in counties like Washington or Greene, so activity varies significantly by township.
